headline: Moroccan produce traders expect vegetable prices to normalize within three weeks
summary: Agricultural traders in Morocco project wholesale prices for tomatoes, potatoes, and onions to decline to normal levels within three weeks as fresh regional crop supplies enter markets.
why: Food supply and vegetable prices strongly influence headline consumer inflation metrics across North Africa.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Increased produce supply is expected to lower local food inflation pressures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
